NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE III: DEFENSE, RAIDS AND THE FALLEN (LCC-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
"If anyone comes to raid our homeland, we'll be ready." Isola's people are peaceful but no pushovers: stamping dances and war chants, watch fires and plans, raids fended off or not, prisoners and bargains, and how the village honors those who defended it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: The healers want bundles of bandages ready for raids: use the good cloth, or use leaves and bark.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject), the healer, wants a bundle of bandages and herbs ready in every hut, in case raiders come and the wounded cannot reach the healing hut. (friend) points out that the good cloth is needed for sails and clothes, and the healers have always managed with leaves and bark. What should they use?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The village gives up some of its cloth, and (subject) makes neat bundles for every hut. People grumble about wearing patched clothes. Then a fishing accident happens far from the healing hut, and the bundle in the nearest hut is exactly what is needed. The grumbling stops.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) makes the bundles from soft bark and big leaves, bound with fiber. They are not as good, and they need changing every few days. But every hut has one, and nobody has to give up their clothes.
